name: Perplexity
summary: Perplexity's Search API and Agent API with web search.

api_key.description: a Perplexity API key, starting pplx- (perplexity.ai/account/api)

notes: Perplexity also has an OpenAI-compatible Orchestrator gateway (/orchestrator/v1/...), batches, files, skills and admin endpoints, not in this entry.
Costs: search is billed per request; Agent responses by tokens and tools.

endpoints.name: Search the web
endpoints.summary: Ranked web results with extracted page content, or people search.

max_results.description: Most results; up to 20 for web, up to 50 for people search.

search_type.description: web, fast (lower latency and cost) or people.

search_domain_filter.description: Limit to these domains, at most 20.

search_after_date_filter.description: Only pages published after this date. Format MM/DD/YYYY.

search_before_date_filter.description: Only pages published before this date. Format MM/DD/YYYY.

last_updated_after_filter.description: Only pages updated after this date. Format MM/DD/YYYY.

last_updated_before_filter.description: Only pages updated before this date. Format MM/DD/YYYY.

max_tokens.description: Cap on total page-content tokens across results.

max_tokens_per_page.description: Cap on page-content tokens per result.

notes: A read over POST: it runs a search and changes nothing in your account.
Date filters take MM/DD/YYYY on input and echo YYYY-MM-DD.

endpoints.name: Create an Agent response
endpoints.summary: A model response with optional web search and reasoning; can run in the background.

input.description: The input: a string, or an array of input items.
input.example: What changed in the EU AI Act this month?

effort.description: Preconfigured effort level, e.g. fast or low.

max_output_tokens.description: Maximum tokens to generate; required for anthropic/* models.

tools.description: Tools available to the model, e.g. web search.

background.description: Run asynchronously; with stream false returns status queued.

store.description: false hides the response from later retrieval.

notes: A read over POST: it generates an answer and changes nothing in your data (it bills by tokens and tool use).
With background true, poll agent.get until the status is final.

endpoints.name: Retrieve an Agent response
endpoints.summary: A snapshot of an earlier response; only stored responses can be retrieved.

endpoints.name: List Agent API models
endpoints.summary: Model ids usable with the Agent API.
